title: UPS block A3 inverter over-temperature: static bypass and isolation
summary: UPS block A3 reports inverter over-temperature. Move its share to the static bypass without dropping the load, then take the block out of the parallel system for maintenance. Lockout at the equipment is outside this simulator: isolation here is the electrical step only.

steps.text: Acknowledge the UPS A3 alarm in the alarm banner
Transfer UPS A3 to static bypass
